title: Drop the Act: Probe-Filtered RL for Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.11467v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reasoning models post-hoc rationalize answers they have already committed to internally, producing chains of *reasoning theater*: deliberative-looking steps that contribute nothing to correctness. This wastes inference tokens, pollutes interpretability, and obscures what the model actually computed. We introduce **ProFIL** (**Pro**be-**Fil**tered Reinforcement Learning) to *reduce theater, increase chain-of-thought faithfulness, and shrink chain length* in a single, drop-in extension to Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). A multi-head attention probe is trained *once* on the *frozen* base model to detect post-commitment steps from internal activations alone; during GRPO, rollouts whose probe score exceeds a threshold have their advantage zeroed. *Our central finding is that a probe trained on a frozen base, with verifier-derived labels and no human annotation, provides a stable signal that suppresses theater while resist

translated_title: 别再演戏了：面向忠实思维链推理的探针过滤强化学习
translated_abstract: 推理模型会事后合理化其内部早已确定的答案，产生“推理表演”：那些看似深思熟虑的推理步骤，实际上对答案的正确性毫无贡献。这不仅浪费推理token、污染可解释性，还掩盖了模型真正的计算过程。我们提出了**ProFIL**（探针过滤强化学习），作为对群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的一个即插即用扩展，能够同时*减少推理表演、提升思维链忠实度、并缩短思维链长度*。该方法在*冻结的*基础模型上仅训练*一次*多头注意力探针，即可仅凭内部激活检测出“事后承诺”式的步骤；在GRPO训练过程中，探针分数超过阈值的rollout其优势值将被置零。*我们的核心发现是：一个在冻结基础模型上训练、使用验证器派生标签且无需人工标注的探针，能够提供稳定的信号，在抑制推理表演的同时抵抗……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ProFIL方法，通过在冻结基础模型上一次性训练的探针，在GRPO强化学习中过滤掉“推理表演”步骤，同时实现减少表演、提升思维链忠实度并缩短推理链长度。
en_tdlr: ProFIL uses a probe trained once on the frozen base model to zero out advantages of "reasoning theater" rollouts during GRPO, simultaneously suppressing post-hoc rationalization, improving chain-of-thought faithfulness, and shortening reasoning chains.
